title: MCP gateway tool discovery after connect/register must warn on failure, with a fixed message
answers: MCP server says Connected but has no tools and no error
desktop add server shows Added but tool list is empty
where is the toast for failed MCP tool listing
should I show the upstream error in the MCP discovery toast
body:
Symptom: in Desktop, a member connects or adds an MCP server, gets the "Connected"/"Added" message, and the server lists no tools. Nothing says why.
Root cause: both callers of discoverGatewayTools threw its outcome away. In useGatewayServers.ts:useGatewayServers the discover mutation had `onError: () => {}`, and in useRegisterGatewayServer.ts:useRegisterGatewayServer the call ended in `.catch(() => null)`. A `skipped: "no-server"` result (the registry row is gone) resolves successfully, so it never reached any error handler.
Fix pattern: show `toast.warning(DISCOVERY_FAILED)` on a rejected listing and also on `result.skipped === "no-server"`. Do not let it count as a failed connect: registration still returns `created` and `discoveredTools: false`. Leave `skipped === "no-connection"` silent, because the credential is mid-OAuth or needs reauth and the server tag already says "Finishing setup".
Constraints: the toast is a fixed recovery string (DISCOVERY_FAILED, a separate constant in each hook: "Connected, but…" vs "Added, but…"). Never put Error.message or the refresh endpoint's `detail` in it, because that can carry a fragment of the upstream server's response body (CWE-209). Tests in useRegisterGatewayServer.test.tsx check the exact string through a mocked `toast.warning`.
applies: Desktop MCP gateway hooks that call discoverGatewayTools (products/desktop/packages/ui/src/features/mcp-gateway/hooks)
